data: One cannot imagine the modern world without the impact of electrical and electronic devices. This course will start with a discussion of the basics of electrical circuits, both static and transient. The main course content is centered around the theory of electronic devices based on semiconductors, such as P-N junction diodes and transistors. A study of these basic devices and their applications gives us the necessary background to design advanced circuits. Finally, the course will introduce the basics of digital electronics, covering Boolean algebra and logic gates.
